name: dsh-plugin-quota-monitor
description: Sidebar footer quota & balance monitor: always-on DeepSeek Rage (¥) + OpenCode Go HP/MP/SP quota windows (remaining %) + SCNet (国家超算) Credits remaining estimated locally from DSH session logs. Provider auto-detect (auto/opencode/scnet), per-meter toggles, billing-cycle reset day and editable rate table in Settings → 插件管理.
